seo.title: Mesa Homeless Help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified practical resources for people experiencing homelessness in Mesa.

page.heading: MESA - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger: 911. Mesa street outreach: 602-346-3361. Local information: 211. Crisis support: call or text 988.
page.notice: Availability, eligibility, hours, and capacity can change. Call ahead when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, job, or legal representation.
page.intro: Call Mesa Street Outreach at 602-346-3361 for help. The city Off the Streets shelter is referral-only and does not accept walk-ins.
page.footer: Information can change. Call ahead when possible and report incorrect information through the GitHub link in the footer.

entries.title: Emergency services — 911
entries.description: For immediate danger, fire, a life-threatening medical emergency, or violence.
entries.how_to_access: Give the exact location and explain what is happening.

entries.title: Mesa Street Outreach hotline
entries.description: Connects people living outside with outreach, assessment, and available resources. Help and placement depend on capacity.
entries.how_to_access: Call and give your current location and needs.

entries.title: Mesa Off the Streets emergency shelter
entries.description: City-supported emergency shelter with food, clothing, and service referrals. It is referral-only; no walk-up intake.
entries.how_to_access: Call Street Outreach at 602-346-3361 for assessment and possible referral.

entries.title: Paz de Cristo Community Center — meals
entries.description: Community meal and basic-needs services. Meal schedules and eligibility can change.
entries.how_to_access: Call or check the current meal schedule before traveling.

entries.title: Paz de Cristo Community Center
entries.description: Faith-based charity offering meals and basic-needs support. Ask staff whether any religious activity is optional if concerned.

entries.title: Mesa community clothing resources
entries.description: The city maintains a current directory of organizations offering clothing and other basic needs.
entries.how_to_access: Use the official directory and call the provider before traveling.

entries.title: Circle the City homeless health care
entries.description: Health care and outreach for people experiencing homelessness in Maricopa County. Clinic and mobile schedules vary.
entries.how_to_access: Use the clinic and mobile-service information to confirm where care is available.

entries.title: Health-e-Arizona Plus
entries.description: Apply for Nutrition Assistance, medical coverage, cash assistance, and other Arizona benefits.
entries.how_to_access: Apply online or ask outreach staff for help; approval depends on eligibility.

entries.title: ARIZONA@WORK — Mesa
entries.description: Free public employment services, job search, career guidance, and training information.
entries.how_to_access: Find the Mesa-area center and confirm walk-in hours.

entries.title: Community Legal Services
entries.description: Free civil legal help for eligible low-income Arizonans; case acceptance depends on issue and capacity.

entries.title: A New Leaf domestic-violence support
entries.description: Confidential crisis support, safety planning, and shelter information for survivors.
entries.how_to_access: Call when safe; call 911 for immediate danger.

entries.title: National Call Center for Homeless Veterans
entries.description: Connects veterans who are homeless or at risk with VA services and local resources.
entries.how_to_access: Call and explain that you are a veteran who is homeless or at risk.
